notes: REORGANIZATION: SAMHSA/NASADAD's SSA listing still names the Department of Alcohol and Other Drug Abuse Services (DAODAS), website daodas.sc.gov. Under Act No. 3 of 2025, DAODAS's functions moved into the new SC Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Disabilities as the Office of Substance Use Services (S.C. Code §44-49-10 makes OSUS DAODAS's statutory successor); daodas.sc.gov now serves the BHDD site, and the OSUS Recovery page at bhdd.sc.gov was fetched and verified in-run. Agency phone is the OSUS/DAODAS office number (400 Otarre Parkway, Cayce) published on daodas.sc.gov. SAFETY FLAG: the legacy SC Department of Mental Health domain scdmh.net has lapsed and now serves online-casino spam — never link it; SC crisis/mental-health services now live under bhdd.sc.gov. SC Mobile Crisis (833-364-2274) is BHDD's 24/7/365 statewide crisis dispatch (formerly SC DMH's Community Crisis Response & Intervention). Healthy Connections Medicaid (SCDHHS) covers SUD services including MAT, detox and intensive outpatient. County services run through the '301 system' of county alcohol and drug abuse authorities listed in the verified BHSA directory.
